title: 信息日报 2026-08-18

headline.title: 科学家将DNA转化为内存设备 能耗降低百倍
headline.summary: 研究人员将合成DNA与半导体结合，创造出一种超低功耗内存设备，可在同一位置存储和处理信息。这种生物混合技术有望显著提升AI系统和下一代计算机的能效，为未来计算设备开辟新的可能。
headline.title_en: Scientists turn DNA into a memory device that uses 100x less power
headline.summary_en: Researchers combined synthetic DNA with a semiconductor to create an ultra-low-power memory device capable of storing and processing information in the same place. This bio-hybrid technology, described as a potential game-changer, could eventually help make AI systems and next-generation computers far more energy efficient, addressing a key bottleneck in computing performance and sustainability.
headline.original_title: Scientists turn DNA into a memory device that uses 100x less power
headline.reason: 该成果将生物分子与半导体结合，有望大幅降低AI计算的能耗，是当天的重大科技突破，且综合评分最高。
headline.reason_en: This breakthrough merges biological molecules with semiconductors, potentially slashing AI computing energy consumption. It is the top-scoring science story with broad implications for future computing.
